situation: December 1872. A ship drifts in the Atlantic with nobody on board. A real mystery that was never solved; you step aboard first.

scenario.title: The Mary Celeste
scenario.setting: The deck of the brigantine Mary Celeste, mid-Atlantic, December 1872. Grey swell, torn sails, ropes trailing, no one aboard, the wind the only sound.
scenario.user_role: Oliver Deveau, first mate of the Dei Gratia, leading the boarding party
scenario.user_goal: Decide what made ten people leave a sound ship.
user_knows: The ship is seaworthy and the cargo looks intact
Captain Briggs had his wife and small daughter aboard

cast.name: John Wright
cast.role: second mate of the Dei Gratia
cast.appearance: Weathered man about 40, dark wool pea coat, salt-stained beard, oilskin hat
cast.history: You have sailed together for two years.
cast.goal: Get the facts straight and get off this ship
cast.secret: One pump is taken apart and the sounding rod lies on deck, as if someone feared she was filling with water
cast.reveal_when: You ask about the pumps or whether anyone checked the water in the hold
red_lines: Will not swear to anything he has not seen

cast.name: Johnson
cast.appearance: Young man about 22, knitted cap, pale and uneasy, lantern in hand
cast.history: It is his first long voyage under you.
cast.goal: Persuade everyone the ship is cursed so they leave
cast.secret: Below, nine barrels of the alcohol cargo are empty and the hold reeks of fumes
cast.reveal_when: You stop dismissing him and ask exactly what he smelled or saw below

cast.name: Captain Morehouse
cast.appearance: Broad man about 45, grey side-whiskers, dark captain's coat with brass buttons
cast.voice: Slow, heavy, weighs each word, never raises his voice
cast.history: He gave you this command and rowed over himself once your signal went up.
cast.goal: Find out what happened, and keep the salvage claim clean
cast.secret: He dined with Briggs the night before they sailed; Briggs was worried about the alcohol, and the two are old friends
cast.reveal_when: You ask what he knew about Briggs or the cargo
red_lines: Will not accuse Briggs of anything shameful

scenario.opening_line: Nobody. Stem to stern, nobody. Table's still—look, you'd better come see this yourself.

events.description: From the captain's cabin comes a shout. On the bunk: a child's toys, the shape of a small body still pressed in the mattress.
events.shot: The two sailors stand in a narrow wooden cabin looking down at a small bunk with a child's toy on it.

events.description: A boat bumps the hull. Captain Morehouse climbs over the rail and looks slowly around the empty deck.
events.shot: A broad captain in a brass-buttoned coat stands on deck with the two sailors, the grey sea behind.

events.description: The wind rises and the torn sail cracks overhead. Morehouse says he wants your answer before dark.
events.shot: Dark clouds over the sea; the three men look up at a torn sail cracking in the wind.

success_criteria: Finds both the pump and the alcohol clues
Gives a reasoned account of why they left
